sources.name: AdmissionSight College Acceptance Rates
sources.role: Only v1 college statistics seed: school list, national university rank, class-year acceptance rates.
sources.note: If a class-year rate is blank, the app uses the latest non-empty value and lowers data quality.

sources.name: CollegeVine
sources.role: Reference only for student profile fields and multi-factor chancing presentation.
sources.note: No CollegeVine proprietary model, score, or copied probability formula is used.

sources.name: AdmitRanking
sources.role: Reference for China high school context dimensions.
sources.note: High school calibration remains a disclosed proxy when school-specific admissions outcomes are unavailable.

sources.name: Official admissions pages / Common Data Set
sources.role: Preferred source for hard gates, test policies, language proof, round restrictions, and portfolio requirements.
sources.refresh_mode: Semi-automatic source_url refresh plus manual review
sources.note: Official hard gates override probability math; unmet official gates return 0%.

sources.name: SEVIS China state proxy
sources.role: Excluded from undergraduate admissions probability math unless a future source can isolate undergraduate admits.
sources.note: SEVIS active records are not undergraduate-admit counts and are not used in the current model.

sources.name: International student proxy signals
sources.role: Undergraduate-only nonresident share, international aid policy, and optional international-admit coefficient.
sources.refresh_mode: Reviewed CSV now; future IPEDS/CDS/official undergraduate admissions refresh script
sources.note: International admit coefficient is used only when undergraduate international admitted count and total admitted count are both available.

sources.name: China undergraduate admission counts
sources.role: Undergraduate China student admit-count signal by college and round.
sources.refresh_mode: User-provided table extraction with manual review
sources.note: Used as China applicant access signal. It is not all admitted students or international admitted students unless paired with official totals.

sources.name: Academic benchmark proxy
sources.role: College-specific academic comparison layer for GPA, class rank, SAT/ACT, and course rigor.
sources.refresh_mode: Reviewed CSV; replace inferred rows with official CDS/class profile values when available
sources.note: Uses CollegeVine-style public chancing concepts only. Current rows are inferred from selectivity/rank unless a row source says otherwise.
